facts.title: Summer Squash Salad with Lemon Citronette
ingredients: ¼ cup pine nuts (or slivered almonds or sunflower seeds)
2 pounds mixed baby zucchini and yellow squash
½ to 1 cup quality feta cheese, crumbled
½ teaspoon finely grated lemon zest
1 large garlic clove, pressed or minced
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
